AwardArtifact.title: AwardArtifact
AwardArtifact.description: A digitized trophy, certificate, medal, or historic building archived by Xinsheng Elementary School.

title.description: Name of the award or competition honor.

recipientName.description: Name of the winning student, teacher, or school team.

awardDate.description: ISO date string YYYY-MM-DD when the award was won.

awardYear.description: Four-digit calendar year extracted from awardDate.

category.description: Type of physical award artifact or historic building.

mediaType.description: Whether the digitized record is a photograph or video.

mediaUrl.description: URL path to the uploaded or archival image/video asset.

accessionNumber.description: Unique archival catalog identifier such as XS-1994-001.

issuingBody.description: Organization or institution presenting the award.

notes.description: Curatorial notes, material description, or preservation condition.

isPublic.description: Whether the artifact is displayed in the public exhibition.

createdBy.description: UID of the archivist who digitized this record.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of initial archival creation.

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private user account metadata for signed-in school archivists.

AdminRegistry.title: AdminRegistry
AdminRegistry.description: Trusted registry of school archive administrators.

/awards/{awardId}.description: Digitized trophies, certificates, medals, and historic buildings for public exhibition and internal archival.

/users/{userId}.description: Private profile records for school archivists, isolated to owner and admin.
